integrity: All displayed comparisons are derived from the exact matrix exponential. The motivating source was inspected in full relevant sections, and the claim was compared against classical stochastic-oscillator and multidimensional early-warning literature. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary local linearization only; no claim about finite-window estimators, nonlinear escape, or integrated correlation time. Classical CAR(2) autocorrelation formulas are prior art; the contribution is the source-specific comparison theorem and correction.
title: Sampling-lag reversal of inertial autocorrelation near a saddle node
